user: Is the deadline the same for every reason code?
answer:
No, the deadline depends on the reason code. Each code has its own window, counted in days from the transaction date:

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

A dispute opened after its window closes is not eligible. The reason code must also match what actually happened, because a dispute filed under the wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past the window.

For TX-0401, the goods_not_received window is 90 days, and the eligibility check I ran earlier gave a deadline of 18 October 2026. The dispute has not been opened yet. Reply "yes" if you want me to open it for EUR 240.00 under goods_not_received.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each dispute reason code has its own window, counted in days from the
transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Reason code guide
## Choosing a code
The reason code must match what actually happened. A dispute filed under the
wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past its window.

Glossary
## Reason code
The classification of why a transaction is disputed. The reason code determines
the chargeback window and the evidence required.

Glossary
## Chargeback window
The number of days, counted from the transaction date, during which a dispute
may be raised under a given reason code.
